LinkLuaModifier("modifier_wall", "modifiers/modifier_wall", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

if SpawnWallManager == nil then
    SpawnWallManager = class({})
end

local function EnsureWallState(pid)
    GameState.wall_state = GameState.wall_state or {}
    if not GameState.wall_state[pid] then
        GameState.wall_state[pid] = {
            recruit_count = 0,
            extra_cols = {},
            extra_counts = {},
            base_positions = {},
            good_base_positions = {},
        }
    end
    return GameState.wall_state[pid]
end

local function BuildExtraSet(state)
    local set = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        set[key] = true
    end
    return set
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if GameState.spawn_points[pid] then
        return GameState.spawn_points[pid]
    end

    local points = {
        good = {},
        bad = {},
        good_keys = {},
        bad_keys = {},
    }

    for i = 1, 7, 1 do
        local good_name = "spawn_point_" .. i
        local bad_name = "monster_spawn_point_" .. i
        local good_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, good_name)
        local bad_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, bad_name)
        if good_point then
            local idx = good_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.good[idx] = good_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.good_keys, idx)
        end
        if bad_point then
            local idx = bad_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.bad[idx] = bad_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.bad_keys, idx)
        end
    end

    GameState.spawn_points[pid] = points
    return points
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not GameState.walls[pid] then
        GameState.walls[pid] = {}
    end

    for key, value in pairs(points.bad) do
        if not GameState.walls[pid][key] then
            local pos = Vector(value.x, 200, 135)
            local wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall_dummy", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
            if wall then
                wall:SetHullRadius(125)
                wall:AddNoDraw()
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
                wall.transfer_damage = true
                GameState.walls[pid][key] = wall:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:InitPlayer(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    for key, pos in pairs(points.bad) do
        state.base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, 200, 135)
    end
    for key, pos in pairs(points.good) do
        state.good_base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    end
end

local function FindIndexByKey(list, key)
    if not list then
        return nil
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(list) do
        if value == key then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, bad_key, count)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys or not points.good_keys then
        return
    end

    local idx = FindIndexByKey(points.bad_keys, bad_key)
    if not idx then
        return
    end

    local good_key = points.good_keys[idx]
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local base = state.good_base_positions[good_key]
    if not base then
        return
    end

    local new_slot = "extra_" .. tostring(good_key) .. "_" .. tostring(count)
    if points.good[new_slot] then
        return
    end

    local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y + 250 * count, base.z)
    points.good[new_slot] = pos
    table.insert(points.good_keys, new_slot)

    if Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid] and Shop1Managers[pid].Slots then
        if Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] == nil then
            Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] = -1
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:ResolveTargetEntId(pid, spawn_ent_id)
    if not spawn_ent_id then
        return nil
    end

    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local extra_set = BuildExtraSet(state)

    local idx = nil
    for i, key in ipairs(points.bad_keys) do
        if key == spawn_ent_id then
            idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    if not idx then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    if not extra_set[spawn_ent_id] then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local left_key = nil
    for i = idx - 1, 1, -1 do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            left_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local right_key = nil
    for i = idx + 1, #points.bad_keys do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            right_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local target_key = nil
    if left_key and right_key then
        target_key = (RandomInt(0, 1) == 0) and left_key or right_key
    else
        target_key = left_key or right_key or spawn_ent_id
    end

    return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][target_key] or nil
end

local function BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    local candidates = {}
    local has_extra = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        has_extra[key] = true
    end

    if #state.extra_cols < 2 then
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            if not has_extra[key] then
                table.insert(candidates, key)
            end
        end
    else
        for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols) do
            table.insert(candidates, key)
        end
    end

    return candidates
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraWall(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local keys = points.bad_keys
    if not keys or #keys == 0 then
        return
    end

    local candidates = BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    if #candidates == 0 then
        return
    end

    local key = candidates[RandomInt(1, #candidates)]
    local base = state.base_positions[key]
    if not base then
        return
    end

    local count = state.extra_counts[key] or 0
    local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y + 250 * (count + 1), 135)
    local wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
    if not wall then
        return
    end

    wall:SetOrigin(pos)

    wall:SetHullRadius(125)
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_wall", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})


    state.extra_counts[key] = count + 1
    if count == 0 then
        table.insert(state.extra_cols, key)
    end

    self:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, key, state.extra_counts[key])

    self:UpdateExistingMonsterTargets(pid)
end

function SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(pid, hero)
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    state.recruit_count = (state.recruit_count or 0) + 1
    if state.recruit_count % 5 ~= 0 then
        return
    end
    self:AddExtraWall(pid, hero)
end

function SpawnWallManager:UpdateExistingMonsterTargets(pid)
    if not SpawnManagers or not SpawnManagers[pid] then
        return
    end
    local mgr = SpawnManagers[pid]
    if not mgr.active_monsters then
        return
    end
    for entid, _ in pairs(mgr.active_monsters) do
        local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
        if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit.spawn_entid then
            unit.target_entid = self:ResolveTargetEntId(pid, unit.spawn_entid)
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local count = state.recruit_count or 0
    local progress = count % 5
    local goal = 5
    return progress, goal, count
end

if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 6, [3] = 12, [4] = 18, [5] = 24, [6] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(6, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,
        max_distance = 0,
        snap_distance = 1,
        max_height = 400,
        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 6 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToSlot(data, slot, params, onFinish)
    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    self:AnimateDataToPos(data, pos, params, onFinish)
end

function Shop1Manager:MoveDummyToSlot(data, slot)
    if not data or not slot then return end

    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then return end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end

    if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp and not data.Autocast.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        data.Autocast.dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:HandleDummyDrag(dummy, targetPos, allowOccupied)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return false end

    local currentSlot, data = self:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not currentSlot or not data then return false end
    if data.Moving then return true end
    if allowOccupied == nil then allowOccupied = true end

    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("HandleDummyDrag", currentSlot, "allowOccupied", allowOccupied, "pos", targetPos.x,
        targetPos.y)

    local targetSlot = self:FindNearestGoodSlot(targetPos, 200)
    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    if not targetSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    if targetSlot == currentSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    local targetData = self.Slots[targetSlot]
    local isTargetEmpty = (not targetData or targetData == -1)
    if targetData and targetData ~= -1 and targetData.Moving then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, currentSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if isTargetEmpty then
        self.Slots[currentSlot] = -1
        self.Slots[targetSlot] = data
        if data.Autocast then
            data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
        end
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if allowOccupied and self:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(currentSlot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
        return true
    end
    if not allowOccupied then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    self.Slots[currentSlot] = targetData
    self.Slots[targetSlot] = data

    if data.Autocast then
        data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
    end
    if targetData.Autocast then
        targetData.Autocast.slot = currentSlot
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
    self:AnimateDataToSlot(targetData, currentSlot, motion)
    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then return end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if hero then
        self:Synthesize(hero)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevelAll(hero, lvl)
    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 6 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local stats = data.Stats

    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        stats:Destroy()
    end

    local autocast = data.Autocast

    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast:Destroy()
    end

    self.Slots[slot] = -1
end

function Shop1Manager:DestroyAllItems(hero)
    print("[Shop] DestroyAllItems")

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        self:RemoveItem(key)
    end
end

Shop1Manager.item_cache = {}

function Shop1Manager:RemoveAndStoreItems(hero)
    self.item_cache = {}

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if value and value.Stats then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if stats then
                local name = stats:GetAbility():GetAbilityName()
                local level = stats.custom_level
                table.insert(self.item_cache, { name = name, level = level })
                self:RemoveItem(key)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:ReAddItem(hero)
    for i, data in ipairs(self.item_cache) do
        self:AddItem(hero, data.name, data.level)
    end
end

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")



modifier_item_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl               = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.hero_name         = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroName
        self.projectile_name   = raw_kv_withlevel.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv_withlevel)
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, nil, self.hero_modifier_sp, {})
            if self.mod then
                print("[Hero Modifier SP]", self.mod:GetName())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then
            self.skill_pure_percent = BpToRatio(tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent))
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,
            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),
            level = self.skill_level,
            pure_percent = self.skill_pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl
    print("[CreateDummy]", dummy_name)
    self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy then return end

    self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local dummy_level = Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(tonumber(self.lvl)) or 1

    if dummy_level > 1 then
        dummy_level = dummy_level - 1
        self.dummy:CreatureLevelUp(dummy_level)
    end

    -- print("[Create Dummy]", self.pid, self.slot, self.dummy:GetLevel(), dummy_level, self.lvl)

    if self.pid and self.slot then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid].Slots[self.slot].Dummy = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()
        local pos = Shop1Managers[self.pid] and Shop1Managers[self.pid]:GetGoodPointPos(self.slot)
        if not pos then
            local point = EntIndexToHScript(self.slot)
            if point then
                pos = point:GetOrigin()
            end
        end
        if pos then
            self.dummy:SetOrigin(pos)
        end
    end

    self.dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    -- self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        hero_name                   = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                 = self.dummy:GetLevel(),
        projectile_name             = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level            = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval         = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range            = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage      = self.projectile_base_damage,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = self.projectile_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level         = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = self.projectile_sp_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level       = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode  = self.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode,

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,

        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,

        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummySP(parent, ability)
    self.dummy_sp = CreateUnitByName(
        "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp",
        self.dummy:GetOrigin(),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy_sp then return end

    self.dummy_sp:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy_sp:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)

    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- print("[Dummy SP]")

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        projectile_name        = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_interval    = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_range       = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        heal_percent           = self.HealPercent,
        pure_percent           = self.PurePercent,
        ability_sp             = self.ability_sp,
        lifesteal_sp           = self.lifesteal_sp,
        passive_sp             = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level       = self.passive_sp_level,
        modifier_sp            = self.modifier_sp,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp:Destroy()
        self.dummy_sp = nil
    end
end

local function HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now)
    if not self or not self.projectiles then
        return false
    end
    local my_interval = profile and profile.interval or 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if other ~= profile then
            local other_interval = other.interval or 0
            if other_interval > my_interval then
                local ready = not other.next_cast_time or other.next_cast_time <= now
                if ready then
                    if (not other.is_attack and not other.skill) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif (not other.is_attack and other.skill and not other.skill:IsCooldownReady()) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif other.is_attack or other.behavior == "Target" or other.behavior == "Position" then
                        if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
                            ready = false
                        end
                        if not ready then
                            -- keep ready=false
                        else
                            local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
                            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(other.range)
                            local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
                                self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
                                origin,
                                nil,
                                range,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                false
                            )
                            if #enemies == 0 then
                                ready = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local hit_label = "projectile"

local function ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not self or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return
    end
    if not self.special_handler or not self.special_handler.AfterCast then
        return
    end

    local handler = self.special_handler
    self.aftercast_timers = self.aftercast_timers or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        if not self or not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        handler:AfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
        return nil
    end)
    table.insert(self.aftercast_timers, id)
end

    end

    self.owner                       = self:GetCaster() -- hero

    self.hero_name                   = kv.hero_name
    self.dummy_level                 = kv.dummy_level
    self.heal_percent                = kv.heal_percent

    self.modifier_sp                 = kv.modifier_sp

    self.clone_unit                  = nil
    self.clone_mod                   = nil
    self.clone_pause_timer           = nil
    self.special_state               = {}

    self.passive_level               = kv.passive_level

    self.passive_sp_2                = kv.passive_sp_2

        self.special_handler = autocast_specials:GetHandler(self.hero_name)
    end

        self.special_handler:Init(self)
    end

        name = self.projectile_name,
        level = self.projectile_level,
        interval = self.projectile_interval,
        range = self.projectile_range,
        base_damage = self.projectile_base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = self.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = self.lifesteal_sp or 0,
        dummy_mode = self.projectile_dummy_mode,
    })

    self:InitProjectileProfile({
        name = self.projectile_sp,
        level = self.projectile_sp_level,
        interval = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        range = self.projectile_sp_range,
        base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage or 0,

    })

        level = self.projectile_sp_2_level,

    })

    if self:HasCloneProfile() then
        self:EnsureCloneUnit()

        self.attrs_mod = self.parent:AddNewModifier(self.parent, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
            prevent_death = self.prevent_death or 0,
        })
    end

    if self.passive_name then
        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_name)

            if self.passive_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
            ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
        end
    end

    if self.passive_sp then
        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_sp)
        if passive then
            if self.passive_sp_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_sp_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)

            if self.passive_sp_2_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_sp_2_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
            ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
        end
    end

    if self.ability_sp then
        local sp = self.parent:AddAbility(self.ability_sp)
        if sp then
            sp:SetLevel(1)
            sp:SetActivated(true)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = self.parent:AddNewModifier(self.parent, nil, self.modifier_sp, {})
        end
    end

    self.listener_id = ListenToGameEvent(
        "hero_fake_death",
        function(keys) self:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(keys) end,
        nil
    )

    self:StartProjectileTimers()
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end


    -- 【新增】移除监听器
    if self.listener_id then
        StopListeningToGameEvent(self.listener_id)
        self.listener_id = nil
    end

    if self.modifier_sp and self.mod and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        self.modifier_sp = nil
        self.mod = nil
    end
    if self.attrs_mod and not self.attrs_mod:IsNull() and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.attrs_mod = nil
    end

    if self.timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.follow_timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.follow_timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.follow_timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.aftercast_timers then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.aftercast_timers) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.aftercast_timers = nil
    end

    if self.clone_dummies then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(self.clone_dummies) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                dummy:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.clone_dummies = nil
    end

    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.clone_unit:Destroy()
        self.clone_unit = nil
        self.clone_mod = nil
        self.clone_attrs_mod = nil
    end
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        self.clone_pause_timer = nil
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:HasCloneProfile()
    if not self.projectiles then return false end
    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:EnsureCloneUnit()
    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() and self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        return self.clone_unit
    end

    local dummy_name = self.parent and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
    local clone = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
        false,
        self.owner,
        self.owner,
        self.owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not clone then return nil end

    clone:SetOwner(self.owner)
    clone:SetControllableByPlayer(self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local lvl = self.parent and self.parent:GetLevel() or 1
    if lvl > 1 then
        clone:CreatureLevelUp(lvl - 1)
    end

    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    clone:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
    clone:AddNoDraw()
    self.clone_attrs_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(clone, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
        prevent_death = 1,
    })

    self.clone_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(self.owner, self.ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        hero_name                   = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                 = lvl,
        projectile_name             = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level            = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval         = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range            = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage      = self.projectile_base_damage,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = "none",

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level         = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = "none",

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level       = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode  = "none",

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,
        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,
        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
        prevent_death               = 1,
    })

    self.clone_unit = clone
    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
    end
    self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(ttl, function()
        self:DeactivateClone()
    end)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ActivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = true
    local was_hidden = not self.clone_visible
    DebugClone("[Clone] Activate", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "was_hidden", was_hidden)
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
    end
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
    end
    self.clone_unit:RemoveNoDraw()
    self.clone_visible = true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:DeactivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit) then
        DebugClone("[DeactivateClone] delayed (busy)", GameRules:GetGameTime())
        if self.clone_pause_timer then
            Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        end
        self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
            self:DeactivateClone()
        end)
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = false
    self.clone_visible = false
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    self.clone_unit:AddNoDraw()
    if self.clone_unit.SetForceAttackTarget then
        self.clone_unit:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    self.clone_unit:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.clone_unit:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    self.clone_unit:Stop()
    self.clone_unit:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    self.clone_unit:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    DebugClone("[DeactivateClone]", GameRules:GetGameTime())
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneActive()
    if not self.clone_active then
        return false
    end
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() or not self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        self.clone_active = false
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneAvailable()
    if not self:IsCloneActive() then
        return false
    end
    return not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
end
