function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
    }

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return end
    self.follow_timer_handles = self.follow_timer_handles or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        return self:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    end)
    table.insert(self.follow_timer_handles, id)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        clone:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end


        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        return 0.05
    end

    local clone_active = self:IsCloneActive()
    local clone_available = clone_active and not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
    if clone_active and not clone_available then
        DebugClone("[CloneBusy] use base", profile.projectile_name, GameRules:GetGameTime())
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(clone_available and self.clone_unit or self.parent) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
    local use_clone = clone_available or profile.dummy_mode == "clone"

      if profile.behavior == "Self" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, self.owner, self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), interval) or self.parent
          else
              ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                  UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
                  OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                  AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
                  TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                  Queue = false,
              })
          end
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
          profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
          return interval
      end

    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    if profile.dummy_mode ~= "clone" and clone_available and self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        origin = self.clone_unit:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local cast_range = 0
    if not profile.is_attack and (profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target") then
        cast_range = GetAbilityCastRange(profile, origin, self.owner)
        if cast_range > 0 then
            range = math.min(range, cast_range)
        end
    end

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.behavior == "NoTarget" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return 0.1
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Position" and pos and cast_range and cast_range > 0 then
        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist > cast_range then
            local final = math.max(cast_range - 25, 0)
            pos = origin + dir:Normalized() * final
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        if use_clone then
            self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
            profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
            return interval
        end
        local attrs_mod = self.attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = self.parent:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, self.parent, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")

        self.parent:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    if pos and not use_clone then
        self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)
    end

      if profile.behavior == "Position" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              Position = pos,
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
          if profile.follow_facing then
              profile.follow_facing_active = true
              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy
              if profile.ability_duration and profile.ability_duration > 0 then
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = now + profile.ability_duration
            else
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = nil
            end
        end
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
          if profile.follow_facing then
              profile.follow_facing_active = true
              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy
              if profile.ability_duration and profile.ability_duration > 0 then
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = now + profile.ability_duration
            else
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = nil
            end
        end
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)

          profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      end

    return interval
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    if not self.projectiles then return nil end

    if not ability_name then
        for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
            if profile.is_attack then
                return profile
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

WORLDPANELS_VERSION = "0.81"

--[[
  Lua-controlled Frankenstein WorldPanels Library by BMD

  Installation
  -"require" this file inside your code in order to make the WorldPanels API availble
  -Ensure that this file is placed in the vscripts/libraries path along with timers.lua and playertables.lua
  -Ensure that you have the barebones_worldpanels.xml in your panorama content layout folder.
  -Ensure that you have the barebones_worldpanels.js in your panorama content scripts folder.
  -Ensure that barebones_worldpanels.xml is included in your custom_ui_manifest.xml with
    <CustomUIElement type="Hud" layoutfile="file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/barebones_worldpanels.xml" />

  Library Usage
  -WorldPanels are a means of displaying panorama layout files to individuals which act as though they are positioned at a specific point in the world
    or on a specific entity.
  -WorldPanels can be shared with an individual player, a whole team, or all clients at once via
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(playerID, configTable) -- 1 player or array of playerIDs like {3,5,8}
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForTeam(teamID, configTable) -- 1 team
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll(configTable) -- All players
  -WorldPanels are specified by a configuration table which has several potential parameters:
    -layout: The panorama layout file to display in this worldpanel.
    -position: Mutually exclusive with "entity".  Position is the world vector position to display the worldpanel at.
    -entity: Mutually exclusive with "position".  Entity is the entity (hscript or index) which the worldpanel will track for its position.
    -offsetX: An optional (default is 0) screen pixel offset to apply to the worldpanel (in the x direction)
    -offsetY: An optional (default is 0) screen pixel offset to apply to the worldpanel (in the y direction)
    -horizontalAlign: An optional (default is "center") alignment for the worldpanel to use when adjusting the panel size. "center", "left", "right" are valid options
    -verticalAlign: An optional (default is "bottom") alignment for the worldpanel to use when adjusting the panel size. "bottom", "center", "top" are valid options
    -entityHeight: An optional (default is 0) height offset to use for the entity world panel (see: "HealthBarOffset" in unit KV definition)
    -edgePadding: An optional (default is to not lock to screen edge) padding percentage of the screen to limit the worldpanel to.
    -duration: An optional (default is infinite) duration in GameTime seconds that the panel will exist for and then be automatically destroyed.
    -data: An optional table of data which will be attached to the worldpanel so that valeus can be used in javascript through $.GetContextPanel().Data
      This table should only contain numeric, string, or table values (no entities/hscripts)

  -WorldPanels returned by the Create methods have the following methods:
    wp:SetPosition(position)
    wp:SetEntity(entity)
    wp:SetHorizontalAlign(hAlign)
    wp:SetVerticalAlign(vAlign)
    wp:SetOffsetX(offsetX)
    wp:SetOffsetY(offsetY)
    wp:SetEdgePadding(edge)
    wp:SetEntityHeight(entityHeight)
    wp:SetData(data)
    wp:Delete()

  -See examples/worldpanelsExample.lua for usage examples.


  Notes
  -WorldPanel panorama performance can still be an issue (depending on layout).  Use sparingly.
  -A WorldPanel attached to an entity will only show when the player has vision of that entity
  -A WorldPanel is automatically deleted if the entity it is attached to dies (and is not a hero type unit)
  -Edge tracking is currently inaccurate in certain sitautions due to a valve bug with Game.WorldToScreenX/Y
  -The WorldPanel library provides a few helpful properties for use in your layout file's javascript.
    $.GetContextPanel().WorldPanel      contains the WorldPanel configuration in the following table format:
      {layout, offsetX, offsetY, position, entity, entityHeight, hAlign, vAlign, edge}
    $.GetContextPanel().OnEdge          true if this worldpanel has edgelocking/padding and is touching the edge/padded edge of the screen.  false otherwise.  Updates every frame.
    $.GetContextPanel().OffScreen       true if this worldpanel has no edgelocking/padding and is completely off screen.  false otherwise.  Updates every frame.
    $.GetContextPanel().Data            the "data" object passed in to CreateWorldPanel.

  Examples
  -Create a special worldpanel for the hero entity of player 0, only visible to player 0. Adds 210 to the unit position for the height of the panel.
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(0, 
      {layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/healthbar.xml",
        entity = PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(0),
        entityHeight = 210,
      })

  -Create a worldpanel for all players that displays at 200 height above the ground at Vector(0,0,0) and locks to 5% of the dge of the screen 
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll(
      {layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/arrow.xml",
        position = GetGroundPosition(Vector(0,0,0), nil) + Vector(0,0,200),
        edgePadding = 5,
      })


]]

require('libraries/timers')
require('libraries/playertables')

local haStoI = {[0]="center", [1]="left", [2]="right"}
local haItoS = {center=0, left=1, right=2}
local vaStoI = {bottom=0, center=1, top=2}
local vaItoS = {[0]="bottom", [1]="center", [2]="top"}

if not WorldPanels then
	WorldPanels = class({})
end

local UpdateTable = function(wp)
	local idString = wp.idString
	local pt = wp.pt
	local pids = wp.pids
	for i=1,#pids do
		local pid = pids[i]
		local ptName = "worldpanels_" .. pid

		if not PlayerTables:TableExists(ptName) then
			PlayerTables:CreateTable(ptName, {[idString]=pt}, {pid})
		else
			PlayerTables:SetTableValue(ptName, idString, pt)
		end
	end
end

function WorldPanels:start()
  self.initialized = true

  self.entToPanels = {}
  self.worldPanels = {}
  self.nextID = 0

  --CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("Attachment_DoSphere", Dynamic_Wrap(WorldPanels, "Attachment_DoSphere"))
  ListenToGameEvent('entity_killed', Dynamic_Wrap(WorldPanels, 'OnEntityKilled'), self)
end

function WorldPanels:OnEntityKilled( keys )
  --print( '[WorldPanels] OnEntityKilled Called' )
  --PrintTable( keys )

  -- The Ent that was Killed
  local killedEnt = EntIndexToHScript( keys.entindex_killed )

  local panels = WorldPanels.entToPanels[killedEnt]

  if not killedEnt.IsRealHero or not killedEnt:IsRealHero() then
    if panels then
      for i=1,#panels do
        local panel = panels[i]
        for j=1,#panel.pids do
          local pid = panel.pids[j]
          PlayerTables:DeleteTableKey("worldpanels_" .. pid, panel.idString)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll(conf)
  local pids = {}
  for i=0,DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS do
    if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(i) then
      pids[#pids+1] = i;
    end
  end

  return WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(pids, conf)
end

function WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForTeam(team, conf)
  local count = PlayerResource:GetPlayerCountForTeam(team)
  local pids = {}
  for i=1,count do
    pids[#pids+1] = PlayerResource:GetNthPlayerIDOnTeam(team, i)
  end

  return WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(pids, conf)
end

function WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(pids, conf)
  --{position, entity, offsetX, offsetY, hAlign, vAlign, entityHeight, edge, duration, data}
  -- duration?
  if type(pids) == "number" then
    pids = {pids}
  end

  local ent = conf.entity
  local ei = conf.entity
  if ent and type(ent) == "number" then
    ei = ent
    ent = EntIndexToHScript(ent)
  elseif ent and ent.GetEntityIndex then
    ei = ent:GetEntityIndex() 
  end

  local pt = {
    layout =            conf.layout,
    position =          conf.position,
    entity =            ei,
    offsetX =           conf.offsetX,
    offsetY =           conf.offsetY,
    entityHeight =      conf.entityHeight,
    edge =              conf.edgePadding,
    data =              conf.data,
  }

  if conf.horizontalAlign then pt.hAlign = haStoI[conf.horizontalAlign] end
  if conf.verticalAlign   then pt.vAlign = vaStoI[conf.verticalAlign] end

  local idString = tostring(self.nextID)

  local wp = {
    id =                self.nextID,
    idString =          idString,
    pids =              pids,
    pt =                pt,
  }

  function wp:SetPosition(pos)
    self.pt.entity = nil
    self.pt.position = pos
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetEntity(entity)
    local ei = entity
    if entity and not type(entity) == "number" and entity.GetEntityIndex then
      ei = entity:GetEntityIndex() 
    end

    self.pt.entity = ei
    self.pt.position = nil
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetHorizontalAlign(hAlign)
    self.pt.hAlign = haStoI[hAlign]
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetVerticalAlign(vAlign)
    self.pt.vAlign = vaStoI[vAlign]
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetOffsetX(offX)
    self.pt.offsetX = offX
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetOffsetY(offY)
    self.pt.offsetY = offY
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetEntityHeight(height)
    self.pt.entityHeight = height
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetEdgePadding(edge)
    self.pt.edge = edge
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:SetData(data)
    self.pt.data = data
    UpdateTable(self)
  end

  function wp:Delete()
    for j=1,#self.pids do
      local pid = self.pids[j]
      PlayerTables:DeleteTableKey("worldpanels_" .. pid, self.idString)
    end
  end

  if conf.duration then
    pt.endTime = GameRules:GetGameTime() + conf.duration
    Timers:CreateTimer(conf.duration,function()
      wp:Delete()
    end)
  end

  UpdateTable(wp)

  if ei then
    self.entToPanels[ent] = self.entToPanels[ent] or {}
    table.insert(self.entToPanels[ent], wp)
  end

  self.worldPanels[self.nextID] = wp
  self.nextID = self.nextID + 1
  return wp
end

if not WorldPanels.initialized then WorldPanels:start() end

        return

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummySP(parent, ability)
    self.dummy_sp = CreateUnitByName(
        "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp",
        self.dummy:GetOrigin(),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy_sp then return end

    self.dummy_sp:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy_sp:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)

    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- print("[Dummy SP]")

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        projectile_name        = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_interval    = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_range       = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        heal_percent           = self.HealPercent,
        pure_percent           = self.PurePercent,
        ability_sp             = self.ability_sp,
        lifesteal_sp           = self.lifesteal_sp,
        passive_sp             = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level       = self.passive_sp_level,
        modifier_sp            = self.modifier_sp,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp:Destroy()
        self.dummy_sp = nil
    end
end

        "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp",
        self.dummy:GetOrigin(),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy_sp then return end

    self.dummy_sp:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy_sp:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)

    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- print("[Dummy SP]")

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        projectile_name        = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_interval    = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_range       = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        heal_percent           = self.HealPercent,
        pure_percent           = self.PurePercent,
        ability_sp             = self.ability_sp,
        lifesteal_sp           = self.lifesteal_sp,
        passive_sp             = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level       = self.passive_sp_level,
        modifier_sp            = self.modifier_sp,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp:Destroy()
        self.dummy_sp = nil
    end
end

require("spawn_wall_manager")

function InitAllPlayerSpawnManagers()
    local total = PlayerResource:GetPlayerCount()

    for pid = 0, total - 1 do

function CreatePlayerSpawnManager(pid)
    local mgr = spawn_manager()
    mgr.pid = pid
    mgr:Start()
    mgr.buff_provider = {}
    SpawnManagers[pid] = mgr
    return mgr
end

-- 配置文件
WavesKV        = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/monster_waves.txt") or {}
ChallengeKV    = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/challenge_waves.txt") or {}
PermanentKVRaw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/permanent_waves.txt") or {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------------------、

local function CollectSpawnPoints(spawnPointsKV)
    local points = {}
    for _, name in pairs(spawnPointsKV or {}) do
        local ent = Entities:FindByName(nil, name)
        if ent then
            table.insert(points, ent)
        end
    end
    return points
end

local function BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, data)
    -- 1. 显式顺序（最高优先级）
    local orderStr = data and data["MonsterOrder"]
    if orderStr and tostring(orderStr) ~= "" then
        local arr = ParseStringArray(orderStr)
        local ordered = {}
        local seen = {}

        for _, name in ipairs(arr) do
            if monstersKV[name] ~= nil and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        -- 防止漏写：Monsters 里有但 MonsterOrder 没写的，补到最后
        for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
            if not seen[name] then
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        return ordered
    end

    -- 2. 兜底：字典序（保证确定性）
    local ordered = {}
    for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
        table.insert(ordered, name)
    end
    table.sort(ordered)
    return ordered
end

local function BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)
    local result = {}
    spawnPointsKV = spawnPointsKV or {}

    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates or {}) do
        local val = spawnPointsKV[template]
        if val then
            local arr = ParseStringArray(val)
            result[template] = CollectSpawnPoints(arr)
        else
            result[template] = {}
        end
    end

    return result
end


function spawn_manager:GetRunAliveCount(rid)
    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return 0 end

    local alive = 0
    for _, u in ipairs(run.monsters) do
        if u and IsValidEntity(u) and u:IsAlive() then
            alive = alive + 1
        end
    end
    return alive
end

function spawn_manager:CreateManagedTimer(delay, callback)
    local id
    id = Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
        return callback()
    end)
    table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    return id
end

function spawn_manager:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(fromIndex, startTime)
    local acc_time  = startTime or GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local next_wave = 0
    local next_boss = 0

    -- 从 fromIndex 之后的那一波开始（0 表示从第 1 波开始看）
    for i = fromIndex, 999 do
        local w = WavesKV[tostring(i)]
        if not w then break end

        local pre = tonumber(w["PreDelay"]) or 0
        local dur = tonumber(w["Duration"]) or 0
        local isB = (tostring(w["IsBossWave"] or "0") == "1")

        acc_time = acc_time + pre

        if (not isB) and next_wave == 0 then
            next_wave = acc_time
        end

        if isB and next_boss == 0 then
            next_boss = acc_time
        end

        -- 如果找到了普通波生成点，且已经确定了下一个 Boss 点（或之后没 Boss），则退出
        if next_wave > 0 and (next_boss > 0 or i > fromIndex + 5) then
            break
        end

        -- 累加持续时间，用于计算再下一波的起点
        acc_time = acc_time + dur
    end

    return next_wave, next_boss
end

if monster_system == nil then
    monster_system = class({})

function monster_system:ReadEngineBase(unit)
    local name = unit:GetUnitName()
    local base = MonsterStats:GetEngineBase(name)

    if base then
        return
    end

    local base           = {}
    base.MoveSpeed       = unit:GetBaseMoveSpeed()
    local minD           = unit:GetBaseDamageMin()
    local maxD           = unit:GetBaseDamageMax()
    base.Attack          = (minD + maxD) * 0.5
    base.AttackSpeed     = unit:GetAttackSpeed(true) * 100
    base.AttackTime      = 1 / unit:GetAttacksPerSecond(true)
    base.AttackRange     = unit:GetBaseAttackRange()
    base.Armor           = unit:GetPhysicalArmorBaseValue()
    base.MagicResistence = unit:GetBaseMagicalResistanceValue()
    base.Health          = unit:GetBaseMaxHealth()
    base.HealthRegen     = unit:GetBaseHealthRegen()
    base.Mana            = unit:GetMana()
    base.ManaRegen       = unit:GetManaRegen()

    MonsterStats:SetEngineBase(name, base)
end

function MonsterStats:ComputeFinalCacheKey(buffid_list)
    local key_parts = { "Buff" }

    table.sort(buffid_list)

    for _, buffID in ipairs(buffid_list) do
        table.insert(key_parts, "|" .. tostring(buffID))
    end

    return table.concat(key_parts, "")
end

function monster_system:StoreStat(buffs, name, tag)
    if MonsterStats:Get(tag) then
        return
    end

    MonsterStats:AddAllBuffs(buffs, tag)
    MonsterStats:UpdateDisplayFinal(tag)
    MonsterStats:UpdateDelta(name, tag)
end

function monster_system:Spawn(name, pos, buffTag)
    local unit = CreateUnitByName(name, pos, true, nil, nil, DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS)
    unit:SetForwardVector(BadForward)

    if not unit then
        print("monster_system:Spawn failed to create unit:", name, pos, buffTag)
        return nil
    end

    unit._monster_buff_tag = buffTag

    self:ReadEngineBase(unit)

    return unit
end

function monster_system:ApplyStat(unit)
    local mod_ai = unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_simple_chase_ai", {})

    local mod = unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_monster_stats", {})

    if mod then
        mod:RecalculateFinalValues()
        mod:ForceRefresh()
    end

    local tag = unit._monster_buff_tag
    local final = MonsterStats:GetFinal(tag)
    local health = final.Health or 0
    local mana = final.Mana or 0

    unit:SetBaseMaxHealth(health)
    unit:SetMaxHealth(health)
    unit:SetHealth(health)
    unit:SetMana(mana)
    unit:SetMaxMana(mana)

    --print("[Monster Stats]", unit, unit:GetMaxHealth(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime())

    return mod_ai
end

function monster_system:AddItem(unit, item_name, pid)
    -- print("[Monster Item]", unit:GetUnitName(), item_name, pid)
    local item = unit:AddItemByName(item_name)
    if item then
        unit:CastAbilityNoTarget(item, pid)
    end
end

 function BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)
     local result = {}

@@
     return result
 end
+
+local BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE = 10000
+local BOSS_PANEL_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.1
+
+local BossHealthPanels = {}
+local BossHealthPanelTicker = nil
+
+local function BuildBossPanelPayload(entry)
+    if not entry or not entry.unit then
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    local unit = entry.unit
+    if unit:IsNull() then
+        return nil
+    end
+
+    local maxHealth = math.max(unit:GetMaxHealth(), 1)
+    local currentHealth = math.max(0, math.min(unit:GetHealth(), maxHealth))
+    local segmentValue = entry.segment_value or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE
+    local totalSegments = math.max(1, math.ceil(maxHealth / segmentValue))
+    entry.max_segments = totalSegments
+
+    return {
+        segments = totalSegments,
+        segment_value = segmentValue,
+        multiplier = totalSegments,
+        current_health = currentHealth,
+        max_health = maxHealth,
+    }
+end
+
+local function CleanupBossPanel(entid)
+    local entry = BossHealthPanels[entid]
+    if not entry then
+        return
+    end
+
+    if entry.panel then
+        entry.panel:Delete()
+    end
+
+    BossHealthPanels[entid] = nil
+end
+
+local function EnsureBossPanelTicker()
+    if BossHealthPanelTicker then
+        return
+    end
+
+    BossHealthPanelTicker = Timers:CreateTimer(function()
+        for entid, entry in pairs(BossHealthPanels) do
+            local unit = entry.unit
+            if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not unit:IsAlive() then
+                CleanupBossPanel(entid)
+            else
+                local payload = BuildBossPanelPayload(entry)
+                if payload then
+                    entry.panel:SetData(payload)
+                end
+            end
+        end
+        return BOSS_PANEL_UPDATE_INTERVAL
+    end)
+end
+
+local function RegisterBossHealthPanel(unit, segmentValue)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not WorldPanels then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local entid = unit:GetEntityIndex()
+    if BossHealthPanels[entid] then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local panel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
+        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/boss_health.xml",
+        entity = unit,
+        entityHeight = 220,
+        horizontalAlign = "center",
+        verticalAlign = "bottom",
+        offsetY = 10,
+        data = {
+            segments = 1,
+            segment_value = segmentValue or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE,
+            multiplier = 1,
+            current_health = unit:GetHealth(),
+            max_health = unit:GetMaxHealth(),
+        },
+    })
+
+    if not panel then
+        return
+    end
+
+    BossHealthPanels[entid] = {
+        unit = unit,
+        panel = panel,
+        segment_value = segmentValue or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE,
+        max_segments = 1,
+    }
+
+    local payload = BuildBossPanelPayload(BossHealthPanels[entid])
+    if payload then
+        panel:SetData(payload)
+    end
+
+    EnsureBossPanelTicker()
+end

local function CollectSpawnPoints(spawnPointsKV)
    local points = {}
    for _, name in pairs(spawnPointsKV or {}) do
        local ent = Entities:FindByName(nil, name)
        if ent then
            table.insert(points, ent)
        end
    end
    return points
end

local function BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, data)
    -- 1. 显式顺序（最高优先级）
    local orderStr = data and data["MonsterOrder"]
    if orderStr and tostring(orderStr) ~= "" then
        local arr = ParseStringArray(orderStr)
        local ordered = {}
        local seen = {}

        for _, name in ipairs(arr) do
            if monstersKV[name] ~= nil and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        -- 防止漏写：Monsters 里有但 MonsterOrder 没写的，补到最后
        for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
            if not seen[name] then
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        return ordered
    end

    -- 2. 兜底：字典序（保证确定性）
    local ordered = {}
    for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
        table.insert(ordered, name)
    end
    table.sort(ordered)
    return ordered
end

local function BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)
    local result = {}
    spawnPointsKV = spawnPointsKV or {}

    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates or {}) do
        local val = spawnPointsKV[template]
        if val then
            local arr = ParseStringArray(val)
            result[template] = CollectSpawnPoints(arr)
        else
            result[template] = {}
        end
    end

    return result
end


function spawn_manager:GetRunAliveCount(rid)
    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return 0 end

    local alive = 0
    for _, u in ipairs(run.monsters) do
        if u and IsValidEntity(u) and u:IsAlive() then
            alive = alive + 1
        end
    end
    return alive
end

function spawn_manager:CreateManagedTimer(delay, callback)
    local id
    id = Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
        return callback()
    end)
    table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    return id

- Added a lightweight layout and script that draw the multi-“tube” health bar and multiplier label, rebuilding the segments whenever data changes and smoothing the fill ratio of each tube (`game/dzsj/panorama/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/boss_health.xml:1`, `game/dzsj/panorama/scripts/custom_game/worldpanels/boss_health.js:1`).
- Testing: not run (not requested).

Next steps (optional):
1. Exercise a boss wave in-game to verify the tubes/multiplier track the segmented 10k-health logic.
2. Tune `BossHealthSegmentValue` in a wave entry if you need a different granularity than 10k per tube.

PLAYERTABLES_VERSION = "0.90"

--[[
  PlayerTables: Player-specific shared state/nettable Library by BMD

  PlayerTables sets up a table that is shared between server (lua) and client (javascript) between specific (but changeable) clients.
  It is very similar in concept to nettables, but is built on being player-specific state (not sent to all players).
  Like nettables, PlayerTable state adjustments are mirrored to clients (that are currently subscribed).
  If players disconnect and then reconnect, PlayerTables automatically transmits their subscribed table states to them when they connect.
  PlayerTables only support sending numbers, strings, and tables of numbers/strings/tables to clients.

  Installation
  -"require" this file inside your code in order to gain access to the PlayerTables global table.
  -Ensure that you have the playertables/playertables_base.js in your panorama content scripts folder.
  -Ensure that playertables/playertables_base.js script is included in your custom_ui_manifest.xml with
    <scripts>
      <include src="file://{resources}/scripts/playertables/playertables_base.js" />
    </scripts>

  Library Usage
  -Lua
    -void PlayerTables:CreateTable(tableName, tableContents, pids)
      Creates a new PlayerTable with the given name, default table contents, and automatically sets up a subscription
      for all playerIDs in the "pids" object.
    -void PlayerTables:DeleteTable(tableName)
      Deletes a table by the given name, alerting any subscribed clients.
    -bool PlayerTables:TableExists(tableName)
      Returns whether a table currently exists with the given name
    -void PlayerTables:SetPlayerSubscriptions(tableName, pids)
      Clear and reset all player subscriptions based on the "pids" object.
    -void PlayerTables:AddPlayerSubscription(tableName, pid)
      Adds a subscription for the given player ID.
    -void PlayerTables:RemovePlayerSubscription(tableName, pid)
      Removes a subscription for the given player ID.
    -<> PlayerTables:GetTableValue(tableName, key)
      Returns the current value for this PlayerTable for the given "key", or nil if the key doesn't exist.
    -<> PlayerTables:GetAllTableValues(tableName)
      Returns the current keys and values for the given table.
    -void PlayerTables:DeleteTableValue(tableName, key)
      Delete a key from a playertable.
    -void PlayerTables:DeleteTableValues(tableName, keys)
      Delete the keys from a playertable given in the keys object.
    -void PlayerTables:SetTableValue(tableName, key, value)
      Set a value for the given key.
    -void PlayerTables:SetTableValues(tableName, changes)
      Set a all of the given key-value pairs in the changes object.


  -Javascript: include the javascript API with "var PlayerTables = GameUI.CustomUIConfig().PlayerTables" at the top of your file.
    -void PlayerTables.GetAllTableValues(tableName)
      Returns the current keys and values of all keys within the table "tableName".
      Returns null if no table exists with that name.
    -void PlayerTables.GetTableValue(tableName, keyName)
      Returns the current value for the key given by "keyName" if it exists on the table given by "tableName".
      Returns null if no table exists, or undefined if the key does not exist.
    -int PlayerTables.SubscribeNetTableListener(tableName, callback)
      Sets up a callback for when this playertable is changed.  The callback is of the form:
        function(tableName, changesObject, deletionsObject).
          changesObject contains the key-value pairs that were changed
          deletionsObject contains the keys that were deleted.

- Added the same guard in `spawn_manager.lua` before any boss-panel logic, ensuring the helper is the single place that loads the world-panel library and that boss-health panels are skipped when the manager isn’t ready, which avoids the runtime error that used to trigger from `playertables.lua` (see `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/monster_waves/spawn_manager.lua:1-80`).

payload.text:
**Fixing module return and global assignment in WorldPanels**

I'm untangling how the WorldPanels Lua module is handled — require currently returns a boolean because the module doesn't explicitly return the table, causing the global `WorldPanels` to become true, breaking expectations. I'll add a `return WorldPanels` at the end of the module file to make require return the proper table. Then, I'll update the `EnsureWorldPanelsAvailable` function to call require without assigning its result to the global, instead relying on the module to set `WorldPanels` globally. This ensures consistent access without overwriting globals incorrectly.

summary.text:

I'm untangling how the WorldPanels Lua module is handled — require currently returns a boolean because the module doesn't explicitly return the table, causing the global `WorldPanels` to become true, breaking expectations. I'll add a `return WorldPanels` at the end of the module file to make require return the proper table. Then, I'll update the `EnsureWorldPanelsAvailable` function to call require without assigning its result to the global, instead relying on the module to set `WorldPanels` globally. This ensures consistent access without overwriting globals incorrectly.

- Guarded the on-demand `WorldPanels` require so we only call it after `CustomGameEventManager` exists and don’t overwrite the global with whatever `require` returns; both helpers now return `nil` until the library sets `WorldPanels` as a table and fall back safely when the manager isn’t ready (see `spawn_manager.lua:4-13` and `modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua:12-21`).
- Added `return WorldPanels` at the bottom of `libraries/worldpanels.lua` so `require` now yields the module table instead of `true`, which also keeps other consumers compatible.
- These changes fix the “attempt to index local ‘wp’ (a boolean value)” crash that happened when `EnsureStarWorldPanel` tried to call methods on the boolean that was previously stored in `wp`.
- Testing: not run (not requested).

- Added `return WorldPanels` at the bottom of `libraries/worldpanels.lua` so `require` now yields the module table instead of `true`, which also keeps other consumers compatible.
- These changes fix the “attempt to index local ‘wp’ (a boolean value)” crash that happened when `EnsureStarWorldPanel` tried to call methods on the boolean that was previously stored in `wp`.
- Testing: not run (not requested).
